title: System Design Fundamentals
intro: System design interviews are the senior/staff round that tests whether you can architect at scale. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with design fundamentals (the approach, the requirements gathering), then the core primitives — scalability, load balancing, caching, the CAP theorem. High availability and database design at scale follow, then the architecture patterns — event-driven and microservices design. Capacity planning closes the advanced tier, then comparisons and scenario-based design questions.
